resources.name: MOF-5 analogue crystal structures (relaxed, 111 porous)

access.notes: The exact download path may be under /databases/mof5-analogues or similar. Structures are in CIF format.

resources.notes: This is the final set of PM6-DH2-relaxed MOF-5 analogues. The agent must download and use these structures as the input for geometric characterization and GCMC.

resources.name: Zeo++

access.notes: Open-source C++ code for geometric analysis of porous crystals.

resources.notes: Used to compute Di, Df, AV, ASA with specified probe radius and sampling settings. Includes atomic radii from the Cambridge Crystallographic Data Centre.

resources.name: RASPA2

access.notes: Open-source Monte Carlo simulation code for adsorption.

resources.notes: Used for GCMC methane adsorption simulations. Supports TraPPE and UFF force fields.

resources.name: Universal Force Field (UFF)

access.notes: Force field parameters are publicly available and included in the RASPA2 molecular simulation package.

resources.notes: Used for framework atom interactions in GCMC.

resources.name: TraPPE methane model

access.notes: Methane force field parameters are publicly known and included in the RASPA2 molecular simulation package.

resources.notes: Used for methane-methane interactions in GCMC. Lorentz-Berthelot mixing rules apply.
